headline: Ahsan Habib appointed acting chairman of the NBR
summary: The government has appointed Ahsan Habib as the acting chairman of the National Board of Revenue and acting secretary of the Internal Resources Division.
details: Ahsan Habib, a member of the National Board of Revenue (NBR), has been appointed as the acting chairman of the NBR and acting secretary of the Internal Resources Division (IRD).
He succeeds Abdur Rahman, the outgoing NBR chairman and IRD secretary, who will begin his post-retirement leave starting tomorrow.
The Ministry of Public Administration issued a gazette notification today to formalize the appointment.
Prior to this appointment, Ahsan Habib had been serving as an NBR member for Tax Administration and Human Resource Management.
caption:
A new acting head for the NBR. Ahsan Habib takes over the role of acting chairman.

Ahsan Habib, a member of the National Board of Revenue (NBR), has been appointed as the acting chairman of the NBR and acting secretary of the Internal Resources Division (IRD).

He succeeds Abdur Rahman, the outgoing NBR chairman and IRD secretary, who will begin his post-retirement leave starting tomorrow.

The Ministry of Public Administration issued a gazette notification today to formalize the appointment.

Prior to this appointment, Ahsan Habib had been serving as an NBR member for Tax Administration and Human Resource Management.

headline_marked: 12-year-old [[child's head shaved as punishment]] for alleged theft in Netrokona
headline: 12-year-old child's head shaved as punishment for alleged theft in Netrokona
summary: A viral video shows a crowd of 40-50 people watching as a child's head is forcibly shaved after he was accused of stealing money from a hardware store.
details: A 12-year-old child was subjected to public humiliation and torture in the Panchgaon Bazar village of Kalmakanda Upazila, Netrokona, after being accused of stealing money.
The incident occurred on Monday afternoon when a hardware store owner, Abdul Mannan, discovered 8,500 BDT had gone missing from his cash box.
After being suspected by other traders, the child was found and questioned. The money was reportedly found tucked into the folds of his lungi.
The child was then taken to the Shahid Minar pedestal in the market, where a member of the village police, Ratan Rabidas, forcibly shaved his head using a hair-cutting machine.

A viral video shows a crowd of 40 to 50 people, including businessmen, watching the act. The village police member is heard telling the crowd to record and share the video so others would not dare to steal.

The child was forced to fold his hands and apologize to the crowd before being released. His uncle has since demanded justice, stating the child should have been handed over to law enforcement instead of being tortured.
Kalmakanda police have viewed the video and are currently conducting raids to bring those involved in the linha to justice.

After being suspected by other traders, the child was found and questioned. The money was reportedly found tucked into the folds of his lungi.

The child was then taken to the Shahid Minar pedestal in the market, where a member of the village police, Ratan Rabidas, forcibly shaved his head using a hair-cutting machine.

A viral video shows a crowd of 40 to 50 people, including businessmen, watching the act. The village police member is heard telling the crowd to record and share the video so others would not dare to steal.

The child was forced to fold his hands and apologize to the crowd before being released. His uncle has since demanded justice, stating the child should have been handed over to law enforcement instead of being tortured.

Kalmakanda police have viewed the video and are currently conducting raids to bring those involved in the linha to justice.
